artifact_scope: Local single-RTX-3080 execution gates for external systems. Only systems that pass strict two-model streaming and lifecycle post-conditions receive performance results.

llama_swap.mechanism: OpenAI proxy that terminates and starts one vLLM process per selected model

serverless_llm.status: excluded: stale runtime image failed the lifecycle post-condition
serverless_llm.gate_observation: Qwen2.5-1.5B inference succeeded; DELETE /v1/models/qwen-1.5b removed the model from /v1/models, while the stale local image retained 6171 MiB of total GPU use for the full 30 s verification interval.
serverless_llm.root_cause: The executed image predates source commit 2618762. Its installed delete path drops controller metadata without explicitly shutting down/killing the detached router/backend actors.

current_source_overlay_gate.new_finding: When backend initialization failed before entering ready_inference_instances, current router shutdown did not clean the named backend actor/logical GPU reservation. A second attempt was blocked at 0 free logical GPUs until the orphan actor was explicitly killed during cleanup.

serverless_llm.blocker: The stale-image result is not evidence that current ServerlessLLM intrinsically cannot reclaim GPU memory. Current source remains unranked because a low-cost overlay gate did not complete successful register/infer/delete/re-register and exposed an unverified failed-start cleanup path. Inclusion requires actor-death, scheduler-deallocation, physical-GPU-reclaim, re-register inference, and failed-start cleanup post-conditions on a fresh rebuilt stack.

local_observation_sources.scope: checksummed structured summary; exact command, Ray actor table, scheduler output, and full service logs are not retained

swapserve_llm.status: single-model checkpoint mechanism smoke passed; comparable two-model benchmark not executed
passed_gates: rootless Podman socket and NVIDIA CDI are available
the pinned local vLLM image and Qwen2.5-0.5B model are present
the repository builds with vendored dependencies and native-library exclusion tags
the RTX 3080 driver satisfies the cuda-checkpoint driver floor
swapserve_llm.evidence_scope: checksummed local single-model CUDA-checkpoint/pause/restore observation bundle. Retained controller/chat logs support controller progress and restored inference, but the external checkpoint-state, nvidia-smi, memory, and port-cleanup assertions are summarized rather than preserved as complete command transcripts. It is not a two-model Qwen 1.5B/3B performance result.

kvcached.status: related KV-memory system; composite weight-switch baseline not executed
kvcached.gate_observation: The official artifact previously passed a single-model OpenAI inference smoke on this RTX 3080.
kvcached.blocker: kvcached itself is an elastic KV-cache/memory manager, not a whole-model weight-switch primitive. The official controller can invoke backend vLLM level-1 sleep/wake, but it does not select/sleep a conflicting model before waking the target and its launcher lacks the staged single-GPU initialization required by this 10 GiB GPU. A fair candidate would therefore be named 'kvcached controller + vLLM level-1 + external mutual-exclusion/staged-start harness', not 'kvcached weight switching'. That composite was not executed.
kvcached.note: v0.1.5 contains lifecycle endpoints when vLLM server-dev mode and sleep mode are enabled; the exclusion is not based on those endpoints being absent. No kvcached latency is inferred or reused, and the previous smoke had no retained raw artifact.
